verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the folk API's documented 'Delete a person' endpoint, which lets a programmatic or AI-driven user delete individual records. Nothing in the pack covers retention policies, workspace-wide or account data deletion, or purge and backup timelines. Missing for 10: configurable data retention policies, workspace/account-level deletion or erasure workflows, documented deletion guarantees (backups, timelines), deletion of other data types such as synced emails, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
